name: Painted Folio
description: A painted manuscript or scroll: ivory folio, flat mineral colour, ornamental border bands and register strips that sequence the story (Pattachitra, Kalpasutra folios, Phad scrolls, black- and red-figure friezes). Alternate look of the mythic-tale template.

tokens.texture: Folio paper grain, worn pigment edges (#st-rough), gold-leaf border bands (Studio.kit.mythic.border)
tokens.spacing: --u = 1% of short side; --gap; safe-area insets per format

motion.personality: Ceremonial and orderly: panels open, scrolls unroll, figures appear inside their register; motion follows the reading order
motion.notes: Follow the tradition's reading order and register logic. No camera rotation inside a folio; pan along the scroll instead.

contrast_checked: Below 4.5:1 (accent-3/paper 4.0:1): leaf, borders, shapes and display type 24px+ only; never body or caption text
suitable_for: Jain, Buddhist and Indian folk-art retellings

validation.evidence: Contrast ratios computed from the stylesheet hex values with src/pipeline/colorscience.py (WCAG 2.x), 2026-11-23. Frame-reviewed in Playwright Chromium on Windows through the mythic-film scaffold; not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the M2 host.
